Prima & Timo — Album 2: Centum

Selection Day

"I thought I’d be chosen by the bright and the bold"

[Soft orphanage sounds + distant voices]

[Verse 1] They came in fancy cars, suits sharp and clean Powerful people, smiling like they’d seen The perfect kid they could shape into their dream I stood up straight, practiced every line “Hello, hi, I’m Timo”

The words felt heavy on my tongue Reading was hard when nobody taught you Writing was harder when you were alone I shook their hands with everything I had

Tried to look strong, tried to look glad But they looked right through me, saw the dirt on my skin Another orphan kid, too rough to take in Still, I stood there I never stopped believing

[Pre-Chorus] Morning turned to noon, then afternoon Nobody stopped; nobody gave me a look a glance The gate was closing, hope kept slipping away Then she appeared… just before the dark took the day away - she came

[Chorus] Selection Day I thought I’d be chosen by the bright and the bold Selection Day But life had other plans, quiet and cold She was poor, she was broken, she was in pain She needed a hand, not a perfect name Selection Day I went home with her instead

And it was still the best day.

[Verse 2] She lost her boy to sickness, said the world was too cruel She needed someone to help her carry the load I carried water, I carried wood, I carried her too For three long years, just me and you

She taught me kindness in the smallest ways How to hold on even when the sky is gray But her body was failing, I could see the end Still I stayed beside her until the very end

[Bridge] On a day when I thought hope would be lost I think I got the prayer I wanted the most I learned how to survive this imperfect world By standing strong the way she taught me I should Always stand for what is right Never to hate and never to fight Unless the reason was to protect Always be humble and always respect

I will never forget those words she said

[Solo]

[Pre-Chorus 2] She held my hand when the pain got too much Whispered “You’re a good boy, Timo… thank you so much” Then one quiet morning, she didn’t wake up And I was alone again… just me and a broken cup

[Chorus] Selection Day I thought I’d be chosen by the bright and the bold Selection Day But life had other plans, quiet and cold She gave me a home when no one else would She gave me love when I thought I never could Selection Day I think I was chosen after all

[Outro — soft, reflective] …Thank you, Ma

And it was still the best day.
